verdict.rationale: Convex documents that a deployment can run locally for development. Its CLI watches the filesystem and pushes function and schema changes to a dev deployment, and `npx convex run` invokes functions there. The full open-source backend can also run as a self-hosted binary using the same code as the cloud service. missing for 10: in-depth docs of the local-deployment workflow (the local-dev claim is a single sentence), evidence that the full feature set (auth, file storage, scheduler, vector search) behaves identically locally, independent or hands-on corroboration of local runs.
